answer: Locks are logged in sable, expire in vault, and inlet lists each expiry. Someone running 20 aliases therefore needs 10 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3601 identities would post 1421 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
